newsitem.title: USA: Two boys charged with sex abuse of fellow student.
newsitem.headline: Two boys charged with sex abuse of fellow student.

text.p: Two Dallas middle school students have been arrested and charged with sexually assaulting a mildly retarded 13-year-old boy in the school gym, police said Friday.
The youths, aged 13 and 14, were charged with aggravated sexual assault for allegedly forcing the special education student to perform oral sex on them while two others prevented him from escaping.

The attack was alleged to have taken place at the Sarah Zumwalt Middle School last week after a special education teacher left eight students from his class and two other boys unattended in the gym. The teacher has since been placed on leave and has come under police investigation.
